intent: Preserve complete official producer logo geometry, typography, and identity colours; add restrained antique gold engraving decoration from existing Heritage illustrations.

cards.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict logo identity preservation.
Asset type: illustration artwork for the Kanadea Heritage collectible card, artwork only.
Input image 1 is the OFFICIAL KANADEA logo and the immutable identity source. Input image 2 is an older Heritage illustration and is ONLY a reference for antique engraving linework, stippling, restrained golden rays and ornamental curls. Do not copy any subjects from image 2.
Primary request: recreate the COMPLETE official KANADEA emblem in a polished vintage engraved treatment. The viewer must immediately recognize the actual logo from image 1. Retain its exact centered stylized white hemp leaf geometry, all seven blades and their negative spaces, the small white human/seed shape inside the central upper blade, both tiny mountain line drawings in their original lateral positions, the two small circular dots, and the circular lettering in the original arrangement.
Text verbatim: "KANADEA" in the top arc, spelled K A N A D E A; "ARTISAN CHANVRIER" in the bottom arc. Preserve the plain spaced sans serif letterforms and correct spelling. The text is an integral part of the logo, not a separate caption.
Preserve the white/ivory emblem and letters on the producer's sage green background. Apply delicate printed engraving texture to the surface and discreet antique gold radiance and a few decorative gold scrolls OUTSIDE the emblem. Gold ornament remains secondary to the recognizable white/green logo. Logo silhouette, proportions, symmetry and typography are the priority; do not redraw it as a realistic plant.
Composition: true LANDSCAPE 4:3 artwork, approximately 1360x1024. Put the complete circular logo, lettering included, upright in the center and entirely inside the canvas with 8–10 percent clear space above and below and at least that much at the sides. The logo should occupy about 80 percent of image height and be the dominant foreground subject. Flat frontal presentation, no perspective, no physical card border, no card UI.
Avoid: no new scenery, landscape, seedlings, real plants, people, hands, animals, objects, invented symbols, additional words, altered leaf silhouette, missing mountains, cropped text or cropped logo. Only the official logo and restrained surrounding vintage gold engraving embellishment.
CRITICAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: This is a FULLY OPAQUE printed illustration on solid sage green paper. Every pixel must have 100% opacity. NO transparent background, NO alpha effects, NO cutout, NO ghosted transparency or pale mist. Preserve the medium dark sage green of image 1 directly behind the crisp ivory logo and all letters for excellent contrast. Only thin gold rays outside, no broad golden glow over the logo. The supplied source logo is the authoritative appearance.
